result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cropped restaurant card, cut-off content at the category filter row, and inconsistent card layouts.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cropped off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped/indicated with a partial preview, or add a visual cue (like a fade/gradient) to indicate more content is scrollable

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off at the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but there's no clear scroll indicator
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial visible next item to indicate horizontal scrollability

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white outline on a busy food image background, making it harder to see, while the second promo card below uses a solid dark circle background for the same icon, creating inconsistency
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment (e.g., always use a semi-transparent dark circle background) across all cards for consistency and better visibility

issues.description: Bottom promotional pizza card is cut off at the bottom of the visible screen with no visible text/label besides the '-20%' badge
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content (title, price, delivery info) is visible without requiring scroll cutoff, or adjust spacing so the card is fully rendered
